The '''Encyclopaedia WoT''' (commonly abbreviated EWoT) is a comprehensive [[wikipedia:companion book|companion website]] to the [[The Wheel of Time|Wheel of Time]] series. It is primarily edited by Gary Kephart and Bob Kluttz. Characters, chapters, items, and places are extensively [[wikipedia:cross-referencing|cross-referenced]].

The last novel that was fully added to the site for a long time was {{13}}. As early as 2013, a second version of the site, EWoT 2, was planned.  The books through {{4}} were added to the new site that year, as were early chapters of {{5}}.  During 2014 and 2015, a few early chapters of {{14}} were added to the original site, some of them incomplete, after which neither site was updated for over six years.

In September 2021, work on EWoT 2 resumed; regular postings on EWoT's social media documented the process. In December 2021 they fully changed over to the new site, which incorporated many modern web features. They also added coverage of the television show.

In March 2022 they finally began tackling {{14}}, getting to Chapter 10 around September of that year. Progress appears to have stalled out while they work on the show pages (still finishing Season 3 as of late 2025).
